turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah hi, I brought I brought my 8 year old daughter here um because I've noticed that she's been quite wheezy um for the past four five days and now she has a slight cough, um sounds like she's a little short of breath, so I just wanted to get things checked out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so for the, when it first presented, about four to five days ago, what did you notice, notice first?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I noticed that she was wheezy um and it's it seemed like she was having some difficulty taking in deep breaths.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, now was this with any type of activity or just at rest?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, she was playing tag with one of her cousins and she she was quite out of breath after.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, has she ever had anything like this before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Nothing like that, OK, and has it been fairly steady since then? Or has it been fluctuating?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's been fluctuating.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, but it hasn't really gone away in the sense that you're still concerned coming now four days later?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it's just it would, she would have these these uh episodes, but it would resolve on its own and then she would, you know go back to doing some sort of activity and then she would have all these symptoms all over again, but when she rests um then it goes away, so I wasn't really sure, too sure what to think of it. But now I think it's important to get it checked out, so here we are.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Has she had any fevers at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Has she had a runny nose at all at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Has she seemed well otherwise, does she look sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, she looks fine otherwise.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And has she had any sick contacts recently? Anyone around her or her friends been sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any recent travel anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no, no, we didn't go anywhere because of covid.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, but she's still been going to school I suppose, playing with her friends?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you noticed any rashes? Any skin changes anywhere on her body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh not that I've noticed, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, nothing like that, has she complained of any pain anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has she had any recent infections?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh she had, actually she had a couple of infections over the past two years. Uh they would come and go uh and we took her to the doctor each time and it just ended up being some sort of viral infection.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so nothing really needing antibiotics in the last couple of years?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And in terms of how she's been doing, has she been keeping up with her peers in terms of education, and how she moves, how she acts?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, she's been yeah, she's been on par with her peers.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so does she have a family physician?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so they haven't brought up any concerns about how she's growing, how she's developing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So her weight, her height, they've been good for her age?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Excellent. And has she gotten, has she been keeping up to date for immunizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, she's fully up to date.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Excellent. In regards to how she's doing, otherwise health, in terms of her health, has, did she see a family physician for any other medical issues that she might be having?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, she's otherwise pretty healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. How was the birth? Was there any complications when she was born?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, she was a vaginal delivery, full term, no complications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so nothing when you were pregnant with her, no toxic congestions? By that I mean um did you drink any alcohol, smoke at all when you were pregnant with her?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. And you just had antenatal care, so you saw doctor for ultrasounds and just for checkups?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep, everything was fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And when she was born, she didn't have to stay in the hospital at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And was she born, uh what weight was she when she was born?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, she was, how much was she? I think she was about 8 kilos.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: 8 kilos?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sorry 8 pounds, 8 pounds.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, no worries. And then otherwise she is, so she's been healthy otherwise, been doing well, uh just in terms of how she's been doing uh with other systems of her body, have you noticed any concerns for her bowel movements?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, she's been pretty regular.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any concerns for peeing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, she's been going pretty frequently and she's, yeah no changes there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And we already talked, she hasn't had any fevers, when she coughs does she ever bring anything up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I haven't noticed any phlegm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when she's having these wheezy episodes, do you ever notice that she looks like she's really straining to breathe, really struggling?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, so she, it's not like she turns blue or anything like that, um she just slightly slightly has a hard time catching her breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so these usually recover on their own?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You don't give her anything for it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh does she have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, well she has some seasonal allergies, but nothing that she's been tested for.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you give her anything for seasonal allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes she takes like Reactine or like over the counter stuff, but um no, no prescribed medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so she doesn't have any allergies where her face swells up or she has trouble breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and this, these episodes mainly happen when she's playing with friends, so do they happen in a certain environment? Like for example, is this in a friends house or is this outdoors or has it been across different settings?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's been across different settings but I will say it's worse when um when when there's colder weather.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do these episodes ever happen in your home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what's the context from them happening in your home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um usually when she is out and about running around in the backyard with her friends um is when I've mostly noticed it, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so she doesn't have any symptoms at rest?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And she doesn't have any symptoms at night?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh at night, so there was one one one night when she had some issues um with like wheeziness but it did resolve on its own.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And did she wake up at night with that or just?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just trouble falling asleep, I think yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, so we already talked about, so she doesn't really have any past medical issues that she's seen a doctor for, uh any surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No surgeries.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Is she taking medications right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, no medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Aside from the occasional Reactine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, aside from that, nothing, no regular medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And she's in school?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah, she's uh she's in Grade 3 now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and does she live with you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah she lives with me and my husband.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you two live in a house in town?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yep, in a townhouse

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what do you two do for work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um so my husband is an ultrasound technician and I am a uh kindergarten teacher.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, excellent, and this is a question we just ask everyone, has there ever been any CC CAS involvement in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And does anyone smoke in the household?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh do you keep any carpets or pets in the household?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: We have carpets, but they're new carpets. We just got them, uh maybe six months ago, and nothing else.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So no pets, no dogs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any wood burning fireplaces, stoves in the household?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And changed your air filters?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, excellent, so I think I have all the information I need, we're just going to do a physical exam and then I'm going to go talk to the physician and I'll come in and see your daughter and we'll talk about next steps from there. Do you have any questions that you'd like me to direct to him before that happens?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, thank you so much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, have a good one

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: You too, bye bye.
